excerpts: A tokeniser first divides the text into reusable pieces and maps those pieces to numbers.
A token is a chunk — sometimes a whole word, sometimes part of a word, sometimes just a single character or a punctuation mark.
Input tokensThe tokens in what you send (your question, your document, the conversation history)Output tokensThe tokens the system generates in response
